newsitem.title: USA: John Deere Capital files $2 bln shelf.
newsitem.headline: John Deere Capital files $2 bln shelf.

text.p: John Deere Capital Corp, a unit of Deere & Co, filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to $2 billion in medium-term notes, series C.
When combined with a previous registration, Deere will have a total offering of $2.314 billion in securities available for sale.
The offer will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Goldman Sachs & Co and Salomon Brothers Inc, Deere said in the filing.
Net proceeds will be added to the company's general funds and will be used for working capital and other general corporate purposes.

John Deere, based in Moline, Ill., provides and administers financing for retail purchases of new and used equipment manufactured by Deere & Co's agricultural, construction, commercial and consumer equipment divisions.
